name: Eri
title: Son of Gad
summary: Eri was one of the sons of Gad, who himself was a son of the patriarch Jacob and Zilpah, Leah's maidservant. Eri is mentioned in the genealogies as one of those who accompanied Jacob to Egypt. He was the ancestor of the Erite clan among the Gadites.

keyEvents.title: Mentioned in Jacob's genealogy
keyEvents.description: Eri is listed as one of Gad's sons in the list of Jacob's descendants who went down to Egypt.

keyEvents.title: Ancestor of the Eri clan
keyEvents.description: Eri is mentioned as the origin of the Eri clan in the census of Israel's tribes in the wilderness.

keyEvents.title: Jacob's family travels to Egypt
keyEvents.description: As part of Jacob's extended family, Eri was among the seventy people who traveled to Egypt during the famine, where Joseph had already become a powerful leader.

keyEvents.title: Gad's sons are presented
keyEvents.description: Gad, son of Jacob and Zilpah, had seven sons, including Eri, all of whom became ancestors of their respective clans within the tribe of Gad.
